newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex details refinery spending needs, 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Pemex details refinery spending needs, 1997 budget.

text.p: Mexico's state-owned oil and gas monopoly needs up to 36 billion pesos in investments for its refining unit through 2000, the company's refining director said Friday.
Jaime Mario Willars said at an industry conference that the unit's budget for 1997 is 8.52 billion pesos, 21.4 percent more than 1996's budget.
Pemex's refining unit plans to auction 220 public works projects in 1997 for its refining plants, worth a total of 2.6 billion pesos, he added.
The budget for strategic projects fell 39 percent from 1996 to 2.59 billion pesos, Willars said, while operation projects rose to 4.41 billion pesos, a 128 percent increase from 1996.
Beginning in 1998, new projects will focus on breaking bottle necks at Pemex's installations, protecting the environment and ensuring industrial security, he said.
